Just in time for the Black Friday season, Paramount is offering its best deal of the entire year. For a limited time, you can save 50% off a 12-month Paramount+ Premium subscription, now just $69.99, when you apply coupon code " saveannual50 " during checkout. You're essentially paying just $5.83 per month. The Premium tier, which normally costs $13.99 per month, is ad-free and includes Showtime.

Note that with Paramount+ codes, your mileage may vary (meaning it may not work for everyone).

1 Year of Paramount+ Premium with Showtime for $69.99

This is a great opportunity to watch the new Avatar TV show

Avatar: Seven Havens recently finished airing all thirteen episodes of its first Book 1 season, with its finale Chapter 13: The Root Chakra" released on October 30. IGN's Alex Zalben gave Avatar: Seven Havens a glowing review, although I'd suggest taking his word forit and watching the show first to avoid any spoilers. It streams exclusively on Paramount+. In fact, some of the IGN staff signed up just to watch this TV series alone.

Paramount's 2026 fall lineup includes new seasons of Tulsa King and Dexter: Resurrection, as well as the second half of the final season of All the Queen's Men. For UFC fans, there will be two numbered events for the month of October: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang on October 3 and UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev on October 24.

Paramount+ is one of the better populated streaming services available, especially if you're on the ad-free plan. Several high-profile movies are currently streaming exclusively on Paramount+, including The Running Man, The Naked Gun, and Primate. Its extensive library of media has been bolstered with the addition of Showtime, making it a great service for those who enjoy movies, original shows, live sports, and news. Popular TV shows include Dexter: Resurrection, Marshals (a recent spinoff of Yellowstone), Landman, Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, Tulsa King, Halo, and Yellowjackets.

If you're a UFC fan, then signing up for Paramount+ is a no-brainer. Dubbed "the home of UFC", your Paramount+ subscription gives you access to all UFC numbered events and Fight Nights on demand, from prelims to main cards.

If you watch American football, then you'll be stoked to hear that the regular season starts up on September 9. Paramount doesn't stream very many pre-season games, but that should change during the regular season as more NFL games start airing on your local CBS network. The two free months won't get you through an entire football season, but hopefully there's another streaming deal floating around by then.
